clips.title: The story
paras: Viktori Prism'Antras is an eccentric stargazer residing in a small hillside hut overlooking Darkshire. While the town around him succumbs to dread and looming horrors, Viktori focuses intently on building a telescope to view the heavens clearly. To realize his vision, he relies on adventurous travelers to acquire intricate parts based on gnomish schematics.

Perched up the slope just beyond the gryphon roost, Viktori Prism'Antras spends his days peering outward from the gloom of Duskwood. Amid undead incursions, ravenous spiders, and creeping shadows, his obsession lies far beyond the suffocating canopy. He dreams of building a magnificent optical telescope capable of bringing the stars into brilliant focus, offering a quiet escape from the dread that engulfs the hamlet.

Constructing such a delicate apparatus is no simple matter in a cursed forest. Viktori works from blueprints provided by his gnomish friend, Cog Glitzspinner. To complete the device, he enlists passersby to track down rare lens-crafting materials and mechanical housings, ranging from finely cut glass to metal lenses scattered across perilous territory.
